data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 12m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2020 (2019 GBP 1m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the Property and PCR accounts offset by deterioration in Tech Liability.

named_events.loss_description: Ongoing global pandemic referenced as a challenging influence on underwriting and exposures; PCR business was paused for part of 2020 due to potential economic downturn impact.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 gross claims outstanding were GBP 296.933m. During 2020 the syndicate reports an aggregate net release of prior year reserves of GBP 12.0m, primarily driven by favourable development in the Property and Credit & Political Risk portfolios, partly offset by adverse development in the Tech Liability account. The report notes a large RITC transaction relating to 2017 & prior years which also materially affected gross provisions during the year.
raw_causal_phrases: reserve release of GBP 12m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2020 (2019 GBP 1m)
The reserve release was primarily due to the Property and PCR accounts offset by deterioration in Tech Liability
our reserves proved more than adequate producing a net reserve release in 2020

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No gross prior-year reserve movement figure is provided in the notes; the report explicitly states a net prior year reserve release of GBP 12m (net of reinsurance) which has been used. A large RITC transfer (2017 & prior) occurred during 2020 and materially affected gross provisions (see note 19: RITC Transfer -168,475 gross), which can distort gross movement analyses. Mapping of PCR (Credit & Political Risk) to standard Lloyd's LOBs is not available in the report; line-specific amounts for the prior-year movement are not quantified, so LOB movements are directional only.
